content: Disabling 'Allow new users to sign up' (Dashboard > Authentication > Sign In/Providers) blocks client signUp() with an error, but auth.admin.createUser() and inviteUserByEmail() with the service-role/secret key still work — confirmed via Supabase discussions #3208/#4296 and docs. admin.createUser accepts email, password, email_confirm:true (skips confirmation email), user_metadata; server-side only.
